mapper.select: SELECT S.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME FROM SUBCATEGORY S JOIN CATEGORY C ON S.PARENT_CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID WHERE C.CATEGORY_NAME = #{categoryName}

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.USER_NO, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, P.PRODUCT_STATE, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME, P.PRODUCT_PLACE, P.TRADE_STATUS, F.FILE_PATH AS MAIN_FILE_PATH FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE F ON P.PRODUCT_ID = F.PRODUCT_ID AND F.IS_MAIN = 1 WHERE P.IS_DELETED = 'N' ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 16 ROWS ONLY

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.USER_NO, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, P.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME, P.PRODUCT_PLACE, P.PRODUCT_STATE, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.PRODUCT_EXPLANATION, P.PRODUCT_KEYWORD, P.TRADE_STATUS, P.BUYER_NO, MUP.NICKNAME AS SELLER_NAME, MUP.PROFILE_IMG AS SELLER_PROFILE_IMG, F.FILE_PATH AS MAIN_FILE_PATH FROM PRODUCT P JOIN MY_USER_PAGE MUP ON P.USER_NO = MUP.USER_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE F ON P.PRODUCT_ID = F.PRODUCT_ID AND F.IS_MAIN = 1 WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND P.IS_DELETED = 'N'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.USER_NO, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, P.PRODUCT_STATE, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME, P.PRODUCT_PLACE, P.TRADE_STATUS, F.FILE_PATH AS MAIN_FILE_PATH FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE F ON P.PRODUCT_ID = F.PRODUCT_ID AND F.IS_MAIN = 1 WHERE P.IS_DELETED = 'N' AND P.TRADE_STATUS = 'SALE' AND P.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME = #{subCate} AND P.PRODUCT_ID != #{productId} ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 4

SELECT FILE_ID AS fileId, PRODUCT_ID AS productId, ORIGINAL_NAME AS originalName, SAVED_NAME AS savedName, FILE_PATH AS filePath, IS_MAIN AS isMain FROM PRODUCT_FILE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY IS_MAIN DESC, FILE_ID ASC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.USER_NO, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, P.PRODUCT_STATE, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME, P.PRODUCT_PLACE, P.TRADE_STATUS, F.FILE_PATH AS MAIN_FILE_PATH FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE F ON P.PRODUCT_ID = F.PRODUCT_ID AND F.IS_MAIN = 1 WHERE P.IS_DELETED = 'N' AND (UPPER(P.PRODUCT_TITLE) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{keyword} || '%') OR UPPER(P.PRODUCT_KEYWORD) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{keyword} || '%')) ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.USER_NO, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, P.PRODUCT_STATE, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.PRODUCT_PLACE, P.TRADE_STATUS, P.PRODUCT_KEYWORD, F.FILE_PATH AS MAIN_FILE_PATH FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE F ON P.PRODUCT_ID = F.PRODUCT_ID AND F.IS_MAIN = 1 WHERE P.IS_DELETED = 'N' ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.USER_NO, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, P.PRODUCT_STATE, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME, P.PRODUCT_PLACE, P.TRADE_STATUS, F.FILE_PATH AS MAIN_FILE_PATH FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE F ON P.PRODUCT_ID = F.PRODUCT_ID AND F.IS_MAIN = 1 WHERE P.IS_DELETED = 'N' AND P.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME IN ( SELECT S.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME FROM SUBCATEGORY S JOIN CATEGORY C ON S.PARENT_CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID WHERE C.CATEGORY_NAME = #{category} UNION SELECT #{category} FROM DUAL ) ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC
SELECT C.CATEGORY_NAME, S.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME FROM CATEGORY C LEFT JOIN SUBCATEGORY S ON S.PARENT_CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID ORDER BY C.CATEGORY_ID, S.SUB_CATEGORY_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE /*+ NO_PARALLEL(PRODUCT) */ PRODUCT SET IS_DELETED = 'Y', DELETED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
UPDATE PRODUCT SET IS_DELETED = 'Y', DELETED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT USER_NO FROM PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRADE (PRODUCT_ID, SELLER_NO, BUYER_NO) VALUES (#{productId}, #{userNo}, #{buyerNo})
mapper.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.USER_NO, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, P.PRODUCT_STATE, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME, P.PRODUCT_PLACE, P.TRADE_STATUS, P.BUYER_NO, F.FILE_PATH AS MAIN_FILE_PATH, CASE WHEN R.REVIEW_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_REVIEW FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE F ON P.PRODUCT_ID = F.PRODUCT_ID AND F.IS_MAIN = 1 LEFT JOIN REVIEW R ON R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND R.REVIEWER_NO = #{userNo} WHERE P.BUYER_NO = #{userNo} AND P.TRADE_STATUS = 'SOLD' ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC
